title: E-Commerce Core Flow MVP (WooCommerce Model)
business_value: Provide a fast, serverless-based headless e-commerce core matching WooCommerce's simplicity with Stripe payment and FedEx/USPS shipping.
preserved_behavior: WooCommerce-like order state machine (Pending Payment -> Processing -> Completed)
changed_behavior: Headless architecture running on Cloudflare Workers edge instead of standard monolithic WordPress PHP runtime.

business_rules.rule: Physical goods only. Stock management is strictly calculated at edge.
Guest checkout allowed. Account creation is optional during checkout.
Order inventory is held for a maximum of 30 minutes in Pending_Payment state before auto-cancellation.
Real-time shipping calculations are fetched dynamically via FedEx/USPS APIs at checkout based on package weight and Zipcode.
Transition to Processing state requires Stripe Webhook verification of payment success.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Guest cart containing physical items with stock available, shipping destination Zipcode provided.
acceptance_criteria.when: Guest selects shipping method (FedEx/USPS), inputs payment via Stripe Elements, and clicks Place Order.
acceptance_criteria.then: Stripe webhook confirms payment, order is created in 'Processing' state, inventory is decremented, email confirmation is triggered, and client cart is cleared.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Order Auto-Cancellation on Stripe Payment Timeout
acceptance_criteria.given: An order has been initialized in 'Pending_Payment' state and stock is reserved.
acceptance_criteria.when: 30 minutes pass without a successful payment webhook confirmation from Stripe.
acceptance_criteria.then: The order state transitions to 'Cancelled', and reserved stock is released back to inventory.

edge_cases: Simultaneous checkout of the last remaining item in stock before payment webhook finishes.
FedEx/USPS API downtime during checkout (need fallback to standard flat rates).
Stripe webhook delay or delivery failure (need scheduler/polling fallback to check payment intent status).
dependencies: FedEx & USPS developer credentials & API endpoints
process_impact: Requires development of Cloudflare Worker back-end, frontend integration with Stripe Elements, and shipping API routing.
